name: community/matrix
description: Patrick Hunziker's Matrix library: dense/complex linear algebra, ML, wavelets, PDE, statistics over Fox math-arrays. Headless numeric core (GUI/visualization layer excluded).
residual: 84 of the 123 modules in ocp/Matrix compile against the SDK standard library as of 2026-08-24; the 41 that do not are named one by one in `excludes`, with the reason each was measured to have. The GUI half (WMMatrix, WMStack, WMArrayPanel and what depends on them) waits for std/gui to be installable.
Six modules this package already shipped did not compile until 2026-08-24, and for one reason: the SDK payload had no `Out`. It has now (std/system), and they do.
HomogenousVectors is not in ocp/Matrix -- it comes from ocp/VolumeRaytracer, byte for byte, because MatrixWarp and its neighbours import it. That directory is otherwise not packaged yet.
Two modules crash the compiler rather than fail to compile, and both are upstream candidates: MLConvNet3D (checker) and PMathSSE (parser).

excludes.AVIEncoder: needs Raster (std/gui), which the headless payload does not carry
excludes.ImageLabeler: needs Raster (std/gui), which the headless payload does not carry
excludes.JDMathL: step value of incompatible type -- the source was written for an older array dialect
excludes.LinearPDE: the source is unfinished: a sentence of prose stands where a declaration should ('XXX has to be converted from 2D to 1D first', line 6)
excludes.LinearWindowFunction: end value of incompatible type (FOR over LEN(d,0)-1, line 14) -- same older dialect
excludes.MLConvNet2D: the source does not parse: a ')' is missing at line 342
excludes.MLConvNet3D: CRASHES the checker: FoxSemanticChecker FinalizeIndexDesignator asserts Resolved IN type.state instead of reporting. Upstream candidate; and until it is fixed the file cannot even sit beside others, because ob compiles a project's siblings in its own process
